optimizersodiumaddon.option.aggressive_c: Turns on all of Sodium's culling at once: block faces that cannot be seen, chunks hidden by fog and entities inside hidden chunks. It gains FPS, but some resource packs may show holes in blocks. Turn it off if you see them.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.armor_distan: Maximum distance in blocks to draw armor stands.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.armor_hide_i: Do not process invisible armor stands with nothing equipped; they look the same.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.armor_max.to: Maximum number of armor stands drawn at once (the closest ones). 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.auto_tune.to: On by default: the first time the game starts it detects your hardware and fills in only the settings you have not changed. Turn it off and on again by hand, or run /osatune, to configure everything with your profile. Backups are saved next to each file as .osa-backup.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.better_grass: When the block next to a grass, podzol or mycelium block, one level lower, is the same kind, the side uses the top texture so steps look continuous instead of showing a dirt edge. Snowy grass does the same with snow.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.borderless_f: F11 switches between windowed and borderless fullscreen. If you are already in exclusive fullscreen, F11 goes back to a window as usual.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.chloride_all: Turns every particle off or on in Chloride at once: all the particles of every mod, plus rain, rain drops and block particles.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.coalesce_tin: Many mods clear the biome color cache every tick, which causes stutter. This turns them into a single refresh every few ticks. Colors can take a fraction of a second to update.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.compact_prev: Frees the memory of the Compact Machines 3D preview when it is closed.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.dynamic_ligh: Torches and other light sources light up their surroundings when you hold them, drop them or when a mob carries them, and burning entities glow. It costs a little performance because the light is recalculated when something moves.
Entities that are on fire emit light level 15.
Maximum distance in blocks from the camera for a source to light up.
How many dynamic light sources are active at once. The closest ones to the camera win.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.exact_transl: Draws glass, water and other translucent blocks in the correct order for the exact camera position, even where they intersect. It uses Sodium's own sorting with no limit on the extra geometry, so it costs some CPU in chunks with a lot of glass.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.fast_math.to: Sine and cosine from a small interpolated table, only while drawing. It is more precise than vanilla, so nothing changes visually. The gain is very small.
Distance haze, including the thick Nether fog. Blindness and Darkness fog is never touched.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.gpu_leak_fix: Frees the video memory of render targets that the garbage collector discards without closing them.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.item_distanc: Maximum distance in blocks to draw dropped items.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.item_max.too: Maximum number of dropped items drawn at once (the closest ones). 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.overlay_fire: The flames drawn over your view while burning.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.overlay_wate: The water texture drawn over your view while swimming.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.particle_dis: Particles farther than this many blocks are not created.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.particle_per: Maximum number of new particles per tick. 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.particle_tot: Maximum number of particles alive at once. 0 = no limit.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.reload_count: Shows in a corner of the screen how long a resource reload has been running and, when it ends, the total time for a few seconds. The /osareload command prints the last time in the chat; /osareload on writes the time in the chat after every reload.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.reload_hide_: Hide the loading screen on reload
Does not draw the Mojang logo screen while resource packs, language or F3+T reload. The game keeps showing what you were looking at. The loading screen when the game starts is not affected.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.reload_profi: Measures how long each reload listener takes and writes the slowest ones to the log and the chat, so you can see which mod slows down a resource pack reload.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.skip_broken_: Skip blocks that fail to render

If a block from a mod breaks while a chunk is being drawn, only that block is skipped and the error is written to the log, instead of crashing the game. The block may look missing until the mod is fixed.
Maximum distance in blocks to draw experience orbs.
optimizersodiumaddon.option.xp_max.toolt: Maximum number of experience orbs drawn at once (the closest ones). 0 = no limit.
